ueberUns.headline: About us
ueberUns.description: We are a young, dynamic company based in Duisburg in the heart of the Ruhr region. Our service covers brokerage, management and valuation of real estate. As a professional partner we also support you with all questions around rental properties. DERKO Real Estate has specialized over recent years in renting worker accommodation and apartments. We continuously work on our portfolio to create more living space and optimal service.
